text: なかまを　いじめられて　この　わたしの　ラプラスも　おこって　いるわ　いきなさい！

structure.jp: なかまを　いじめられて
この　わたしの　ラプラスも

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: なかまを　いじめられて
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb says the thing was done to someone, and with を it means they suffered having it done to something of theirs. The て ending gives the reason for what follows. なかまを　いじめられて = 'because its friends were tormented'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the state is going on now. おこって　いる = 'is angry'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: なさい on a verb is a firm order. いきなさい = 'go!'
